5. [Maximum mark: 14]
Let $X$ and $Y$ be independent random variables with $X \sim P_o(3)$ and $Y \sim P_o(2)$.
Let $S = 2X + 3Y$.
(a) Find the mean and variance of $S$. [2]
(b) Hence state with a reason whether or not $S$ follows a Poisson distribution. [2]
Let $T = X + Y$.
(c) Find $\mathrm{P}(T = 3)$. [4]
(d) Show that $\mathrm{P}(T = t) = \sum_{r=0}^{t} \mathrm{P}(X = r)\mathrm{P}(Y = t - r)$. [2]
(e) Hence show that $T$ follows a Poisson distribution with mean 5. [4]
